 Summary
 LIVE: Inter Milan 1-3 Man City - Bartoli puts home side ahead, Fujino scores two, Casparij adds third for City
 Shaw and Hemp on bench for City 
 FT: Hacken 0-0 Chelsea - read report 
 Man City drawn last three matches and sit tenth in table , external 
 What is the Women's Champions League prize money ?

 Inter Milan 1-3 Man City 
 A comfortable save for Cecilia Ran Runarsdottir as Sydney Lohmann sweeps a strike towards goal.

 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 21:22 GMT 21:22 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-3 Man City 
 A double change for Manchester City.
 Sydney Lohmann comes on for Sam Coffey, while Risa Shimizu replaces Carlotta Wamser.
 Inter bring on former Everton forward Toni Payne for Haley Bugeja.

 get involved Get Involved published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT

 Casparij is one of those underrated players. Always gives her all. So hope City can tie her down to a new contract.
 Martin, Windsor 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 29 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-3 Man City 
 Chiara Robustellini sends a ball into the mixe but Gracie Prior clears and City get themselves back on the ball and in control.
 8 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'City are a nightmare to defend against' published at 21:18 GMT 21:18 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-3 Man City 
 Lianne Sanderson 
Former England footballer on Disney+ 
 When Man City play like this they are a nightmare to defend against.
 They have taken it up a notch or two in this second half and they're zipping it more.
 38 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:17 GMT 21:17 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-3 Man City 
 Wow! Mary Fowler fizzes a ball right across goal, with Lauren Hemp waiting to tap home but Marija Milinkovic gets back on the goalline to clear.
 Fowler has another effort saved from close range a moment later.
 City are still banging on the door.
 31 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Unbelievable goal' published at 21:14 GMT 21:14 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-3 Man City 
 Lianne Sanderson 
Former England footballer on Disney+ 
 That is an unbelievable goal from Casparij.
 It's a lovely little ball from Sam Coffey. It was only a small window to put it in the back of the net and it's a great strike.
 42 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Inter Milan 1-3 Man City published at 21:13 GMT 21:13 GMT 
 Kerstin Casparij 
 The captain gets her goal and Manchester City are flying.
 Sam Coffey does brilliantly to waltz past a couple of Inter Milan defenders before laying the ball off for Kerstin Casparij , who turns and chips the ball into the top left corner.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 97 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 21:12 GMT 21:12 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 Another change for Inter Milan.
 Elisa Polli makes way for Michela Cambiaghi.

 get involved Get Involved published at 21:12 GMT 21:12 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page 
 Jeglertz knew the quality of the opposition. City aren't playing in this year's League Cup. So he has to use games like this to trust his whole squad to step up. Running Shaw and Hemp into the ground simply isn't an option if they hope to win things. Good management.
 Toby 
 28 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:11 GMT 21:11 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 Laura Blindkilde Brown steals the ball and drives into the box before trying her luck, but the shot is blocked and the ball trickles out for a corner which comes to nothing.
 0 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:08 GMT 21:08 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 Lianne Sanderson 
Former England footballer on Disney+ 
 The substitution of Lauren Hemp shows that Man City are still going for it.
 I feel like Hemp goes under the radar and consistently assists her teammates.
 31 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:08 GMT 21:08 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 Elisa Polli drills a low strike straight at Ayaka Yamashita. A comfortable save for the Manchester City goalkeeper but Polli is furious - she thinks she's been caught by Sam Coffey as she teed up her shot.

 'What a save' published at 21:06 GMT 21:06 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 Lianne Sanderson 
Former England footballer on Disney+ 
 Great move from Inter Milan. Bugeja does brilliantly. 
 It's a beautiful save from Ayaka Yamashita. What a save. 
 19 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 21:06 GMT 21:06 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 That's a cracking save from Ayaka Yamashita to keep a curling effort from Haley Bugeja out. She just got the slightest of touches on it and it's enough to parry the ball around the post.
 16 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:05 GMT 21:05 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 No hat-trick, then, for Aoba Fujino. 
 That's three goals in her past two games so I'm sure she'll be called upon by Andree Jeglertz for the Chelsea game at the weekend.
 8 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 21:03 GMT 21:03 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 Interesting, this. Lauren Hemp is coming on. 
 The England international replaces Aoba Fujino, while Rebecca Knaak comes on for Jade Rose.
 Inter Milan bring on Brittany Raphino for Ivan Andres.
 5 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 KICK-OFF published at 21:02 GMT 21:02 GMT 
 Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 Off we go again.

 Post published at 21:01 GMT 21:01 GMT 
 HT: Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 The players are making their way back onto the pitch for the second half. It looks like Inter Milan have made a change during the break.
 0 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:57 GMT 20:57 GMT 
 HT: Inter Milan 1-2 Man City 
 Khadija Shaw and Lauren Hemp are both on the bench if Andree Jeglertz needs them in this game, but he'll be hoping his current side can get the job done - especially considering they have a WSL crunch match against Chelsea on Saturday.
